# Data Lineage — Securities Master Data Lakehouse

**Catalog:** `statestreet`  
**Last updated:** Generated by Doc Agent  
**Pipeline:** Bronze → Silver → Gold → Genie AI/BI

---

## End-to-End Lineage Map

| Source CSV | Bronze Table | Silver Table | Silver Rejects | Gold Mart | Join Key | Layer Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `product.csv` | `b_statestreet.product` | `s_statestreet.product` | `s_statestreet.product_rejects` | `g_statestreet.dim_product` (base) | `product_id` | SCD2 applied. Foundation for all securities. Every product has exactly one row here. |
| `generic_product.csv` | `b_statestreet.generic_product` | `s_statestreet.generic_product` | `s_statestreet.generic_product_rejects` | — | `product_id` | Bronze + Silver only. Legacy shadow table; 1 product → many rows. No Gold mart. No PK uniqueness DQ rule. |
| `legal_entity.csv` | `b_statestreet.legal_entity` | `s_statestreet.legal_entity` | `s_statestreet.legal_entity_rejects` | `g_statestreet.dim_legal_entity` | `legal_entity_id` | SCD2 applied. Issuers, counterparties, custodians. Referenced by product.issuer_legal_entity_id. |
| `fund.csv` | `b_statestreet.fund` | `s_statestreet.fund` | `s_statestreet.fund_rejects` | `g_statestreet.dim_product` (LEFT JOIN) | `product_id` | Fund-specific attributes (endness_type, mutual_fund_type) flattened into dim_product. |
| `debt.csv` | `b_statestreet.debt` | `s_statestreet.debt` | `s_statestreet.debt_rejects` | `g_statestreet.dim_product` (LEFT JOIN) | `product_id` | Parent of bond, muni, pool_backed_security in class hierarchy. Adds face amount fields. |
| `bond.csv` | `b_statestreet.bond` | `s_statestreet.bond` | `s_statestreet.bond_rejects` | `g_statestreet.dim_product` (LEFT JOIN) | `product_id` | Extends debt. Adds coupon_type, maturity_date, issue_currency_code. Also feeds fact_coupon_schedule. |
| `muni.csv` | `b_statestreet.muni` | `s_statestreet.muni` | `s_statestreet.muni_rejects` | `g_statestreet.dim_product` (LEFT JOIN) | `product_id` | Extends bond. Adds tax_exempt, state, purpose. Municipal bond specific attributes. |
| `pool_backed_security.csv` | `b_statestreet.pool_backed_security` | `s_statestreet.pool_backed_security` | `s_statestreet.pool_backed_security_rejects` | `g_statestreet.dim_product` (LEFT JOIN) | `product_id` | Extends debt (not bond). Adds pool_type, originator. |
| `right.csv` | `b_statestreet.right` | `s_statestreet.right` | `s_statestreet.right_rejects` | `g_statestreet.dim_product` (LEFT JOIN) | `product_id` | Subscription rights. Extends product directly. |
| `stock.csv` | `b_statestreet.stock` | `s_statestreet.stock` | `s_statestreet.stock_rejects` | `g_statestreet.dim_product` (LEFT JOIN) | `product_id` | Parent of common_stock and preferred_stock. Adds series_id. |
| `common_stock.csv` | `b_statestreet.common_stock` | `s_statestreet.common_stock` | `s_statestreet.common_stock_rejects` | `g_statestreet.dim_product` (LEFT JOIN) | `product_id` | Extends stock. Adds voting_rights. |
| `preferred_stock.csv` | `b_statestreet.preferred_stock` | `s_statestreet.preferred_stock` | `s_statestreet.preferred_stock_rejects` | `g_statestreet.dim_product` (LEFT JOIN) | `product_id` | Extends stock. Adds dividend_right (surfaced as dividend_type in Gold). |
| `listed_derivative.csv` | `b_statestreet.listed_derivative` | `s_statestreet.listed_derivative` | `s_statestreet.listed_derivative_rejects` | `g_statestreet.dim_product` (LEFT JOIN) | `product_id` | Parent of option and future. Adds underlying_product_id, series_id. |
| `option.csv` | `b_statestreet.option` | `s_statestreet.option` | `s_statestreet.option_rejects` | `g_statestreet.dim_product` (LEFT JOIN) | `product_id` | Extends listed_derivative. Adds option_type (CALL/PUT), exercise_style, strike_price, expiry_date. |
| `future.csv` | `b_statestreet.future` | `s_statestreet.future` | `s_statestreet.future_rejects` | `g_statestreet.dim_product` (LEFT JOIN) | `product_id` | Extends listed_derivative. Adds delivery_date, valuation_method. |
| `product_rating.csv` | `b_statestreet.product_rating` | `s_statestreet.product_rating` | `s_statestreet.product_rating_rejects` | `g_statestreet.fact_product_rating` | `product_id` | SCD2 applied. Rating history per security per agency. |
| `product_rating_type.csv` | `b_statestreet.product_rating_type` | `s_statestreet.product_rating_type` | `s_statestreet.product_rating_type_rejects` | `g_statestreet.fact_product_rating` (JOIN) | `product_rating_type_id` | Reference/lookup for rating scale and type metadata. |
| `coupon.csv` | `b_statestreet.coupon` | `s_statestreet.coupon` | `s_statestreet.coupon_rejects` | `g_statestreet.fact_coupon_schedule` | `
